metadata.Name: SQuAD
metadata.Description: The Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD) is a reading comprehension dataset consisting of 100,000+ questions posed by crowdworkers on Wikipedia articles, where the answer to each question is a segment of text from the corresponding reading passage.
metadata.Paper Title: SQuAD: 100,000+ Questions for Machine Comprehension of Text
metadata.Abstract: In meteorology, precipitation is any product of the condensation of atmospheric water vapor that falls under gravity. The main forms of precipitation include drizzle, rain, sleet, snow, graupel and hail... Precipitation forms as smaller droplets coalesce via collision with other rain drops or ice crystals within a cloud. Short, intense periods of rain in scattered locations are called 'showers'.
